description: Changes your own profile fields: first_name, last_name, phone, about_me and company. Send only the fields to change; the others stay as they are, and null or an empty text clears phone, about_me or company. The name is saved for the chosen locale only; other languages are kept. The email address cannot be changed here (website only). Call without confirm first for a before/after preview, then again with confirm and the preview_token.

about_me.description: Plain text about you, up to 600 characters, up to 6 lines. null or empty clears it.

company.description: Company name. null or empty clears it.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

first_name.description: First name in the chosen locale.

last_name.description: Last name in the chosen locale. Empty is allowed.

locale.description: Language slot for the names. Default en.

phone.description: Phone with country code, digits 7-15. null or empty clears it.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: profile_update
title: Update my profile
